analytics_help.output:
usage: ppar analytics [-h] [--portfolio PORTFOLIO] [--benchmark BENCHMARK]
                      [-f FREQUENCY] [--holidays HOLIDAYS]
                      [--output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY]
                      [--from-date FROM_DATE] [--thru-date THRU_DATE]
                      [--classification CLASSIFICATION]
                      [--annual-minimum-acceptable-return ANNUAL_MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE_RETURN]
                      [--annual-risk-free-rate ANNUAL_RISK_FREE_RATE]
                      [--confidence-level CONFIDENCE_LEVEL]
                      [--portfolio-value PORTFOLIO_VALUE]
                      [--currency-symbol CURRENCY_SYMBOL]
                      [site_directory]

Write Axys/APX analytics reports from a configured site folder.

positional arguments:
  site_directory        Folder containing analytics ppar.yaml and source CSV files. Defaults to the current folder.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --portfolio PORTFOLIO
                        Override YAML analytics.portfolio for this run.
  --benchmark BENCHMARK
                        Override YAML analytics.benchmark for this run.
  -f FREQUENCY, --frequency FREQUENCY
                        Reporting frequency: monthly, quarterly, yearly, or m/q/y. Overrides YAML analytics.frequency for this run. When omitted from both places, source periods are preserved and Risk Statistics is not written.
  --holidays HOLIDAYS   Override YAML analytics.holidays with a headerless file containing one YYYY-MM-DD holiday per line.
  --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
                        Override YAML analytics.output_directory for this run.
  --from-date FROM_DATE
                        Override YAML analytics.from_date with an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD start.
  --thru-date THRU_DATE
                        Override YAML analytics.thru_date with an inclusive YYYY-MM-DD end.
  --classification CLASSIFICATION
                        Override YAML analytics.classification for this run.
  --annual-minimum-acceptable-return ANNUAL_MINIMUM_ACCEPTABLE_RETURN
                        Override YAML analytics.annual_minimum_acceptable_return for this run.
  --annual-risk-free-rate ANNUAL_RISK_FREE_RATE
                        Override YAML analytics.annual_risk_free_rate for this run.
  --confidence-level CONFIDENCE_LEVEL
                        Override YAML analytics.confidence_level for this run.
  --portfolio-value PORTFOLIO_VALUE
                        Override YAML analytics.portfolio_value for this run.
  --currency-symbol CURRENCY_SYMBOL
                        Override YAML analytics.currency_symbol for this run.

Examples:
  ppar analytics ./my_ppar_analytics
  ppar analytics

audit_help.output:
usage: ppar audit [-h] [--output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY] [--title TITLE]
                  [--html-only | --xlsx-only | --csv-only]
                  [site_directory]

Write PPAR Audit review packages.

positional arguments:
  site_directory        Audit workspace containing ppar.yaml. Defaults to the current folder.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --output-directory OUTPUT_DIRECTORY
                        Write this run's output to a different directory.
  --title TITLE         Use one title for both portfolio and security reports.
  --html-only           Write HTML without XLSX for this run. The standard run writes both.
  --xlsx-only           Write XLSX without HTML for this run. The standard run writes both.
  --csv-only            Write the canonical CSV review tables without XLSX or HTML for this run.

Examples:
  ppar audit ./my_ppar_audit

help.output:
usage: ppar <command> [options]

commands:
  setup                   Create a local PPAR Audit workspace.
  audit                   Write Audit reports from a configured workspace.

options:
  -h, --help              Show this help message and exit.

Examples:
  ppar setup ./my_ppar_audit
  ppar audit ./my_ppar_audit

no_arguments.output:
PPAR Audit explains why reported portfolio performance changed.

First-time setup:
  ppar setup ./my_ppar_audit

Then run:
  ppar audit ./my_ppar_audit

For command help:
  ppar -h

setup_help.output:
usage: ppar setup [-h] [--analytics | --generic-analytics] [--overwrite]
                  workspace_directory

Create a PPAR Audit workspace.

positional arguments:
  workspace_directory  Folder that will contain the selected PPAR workspace.

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --analytics          Create a PPAR Analytics workspace instead of a PPAR Audit workspace.
  --generic-analytics  Create a Generic Analytics Python workspace instead of a PPAR Audit workspace.
  --overwrite          Replace existing workspace files with packaged files.

Examples:
  ppar setup ./my_ppar_audit
  ppar setup ./my_ppar_analytics --analytics
  ppar setup ./my_ppar_generic_analytics --generic-analytics
